# The server's env contract: the songstress service's environment in its
# compose.yaml (forward), and what its env-contract test lists as set by the
# image (internal). Refresh from a server checkout, then review the diff:
#   SONGSTRESS_SERVER_REPO=<checkout> go test -count=1 ./internal/deploy -run TestServerEnvSnapshot -update
forward TZ=${TZ:-UTC}
forward PUID=${PUID:-1000}
forward PGID=${PGID:-1000}
forward SONGSTRESS_ADMIN_EMAIL=${SONGSTRESS_ADMIN_EMAIL:-}
forward SONGSTRESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${SONGSTRESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-}
forward SONGSTRESS_PUBLIC_URL=${SONGSTRESS_PUBLIC_URL:-}
forward ENABLE_TELEMETRY=${ENABLE_TELEMETRY:-true}
forward SONGSTRESS_PB_EGRESS=${SONGSTRESS_PB_EGRESS:-direct}
forward LOG_LEVEL=${LOG_LEVEL:-INFO}
forward WRAPPED_REEL_MODE=${WRAPPED_REEL_MODE:-motion}
forward MUSIC_LIBRARIES=${MUSIC_LIBRARIES:-Main=/music}
forward SWEEP_CRON=${SWEEP_CRON:-0 */6 * * *}
forward WORKERS=${WORKERS:-5}
forward DURATION_TOLERANCE_S=${DURATION_TOLERANCE_S:-3}
forward SERVICE_ORDER=${SERVICE_ORDER:-}
forward SPOTIFLAC_SOURCES=${SPOTIFLAC_SOURCES:-}
forward DISCOGRAPHY_OUTPUT_TEMPLATE=${DISCOGRAPHY_OUTPUT_TEMPLATE:-}
forward FILENAME_TEMPLATE=${FILENAME_TEMPLATE:-}
forward RETRY_TRANSIENT_HOURS=${RETRY_TRANSIENT_HOURS:-6}
forward RETRY_NOMATCH_DAYS=${RETRY_NOMATCH_DAYS:-30}
forward ROTATE_AFTER_FAILS=${ROTATE_AFTER_FAILS:-6}
forward MAX_ROTATIONS=${MAX_ROTATIONS:-50}
forward SONGSTRESS_MANAGED_NAVIDROME=${SONGSTRESS_MANAGED_NAVIDROME:-1}
forward NAVIDROME_URL=${NAVIDROME_URL:-http://navidrome:4533}
forward NAVIDROME_USERNAME=${NAVIDROME_USERNAME:-admin}
forward NAVIDROME_PASSWORD=${NAVIDROME_PASSWORD:?set NAVIDROME_PASSWORD in .env (any strong value)}
forward AUDIOMUSE_URL=${AUDIOMUSE_URL:-}
forward AUDIOMUSE_API_TOKEN=${AUDIOMUSE_API_TOKEN:-}
forward SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID=${SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID:-}
forward SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET=${SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET:-}
forward SPOTIFY_REDIRECT_URI=${SPOTIFY_REDIRECT_URI:-}
forward LASTFM_API_KEY=${LASTFM_API_KEY:-}
forward LASTFM_API_SECRET=${LASTFM_API_SECRET:-}
forward GLUETUN_URL=${GLUETUN_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8000}
forward GLUETUN_API_KEY=${GLUETUN_API_KEY:-}
forward YTDLP_COOKIES_FILE=${YTDLP_COOKIES_FILE:-}
forward SONGSTRESS_ANTRA_API_KEY=${SONGSTRESS_ANTRA_API_KEY:-}
forward SONGSTRESS_COMMUNITY_API_KEY=${SONGSTRESS_COMMUNITY_API_KEY:-}
forward SONGSTRESS_QOBUZ_APP_ID=${SONGSTRESS_QOBUZ_APP_ID:-}
forward SONGSTRESS_QOBUZ_APP_SECRET=${SONGSTRESS_QOBUZ_APP_SECRET:-}
forward SONGSTRESS_PROVIDER_ENDPOINTS=${SONGSTRESS_PROVIDER_ENDPOINTS:-}
forward SONGSTRESS_PROVIDER_ENDPOINTS_REFRESH=${SONGSTRESS_PROVIDER_ENDPOINTS_REFRESH:-}
forward SMTP_HOST=${SMTP_HOST:-}
forward SMTP_PORT=${SMTP_PORT:-587}
forward SMTP_USERNAME=${SMTP_USERNAME:-}
forward SMTP_PASSWORD=${SMTP_PASSWORD:-}
forward SMTP_FROM=${SMTP_FROM:-}
forward SMTP_TO=${SMTP_TO:-}
forward SMTP_STARTTLS=${SMTP_STARTTLS:-true}
forward HISTORY_IMPORT_PATH=${HISTORY_IMPORT_PATH:-}
internal POCKETBASE_URL
internal APP_VERSION
internal WORKER_HEARTBEAT_FILE
internal TRANSCODE_CACHE_DIR
internal AUDITION_CACHE_DIR
internal PROVIDER_SEARCH_PORT
internal EGRESS_PROBE_TARGET
internal EGRESS_PROBE_INTERVAL_S
internal SONGSTRESS_ADMIN_GENERATED
